lines: It will take {slots} of your time.
Your time is mine until I say otherwise.
It lasts as long as I want it to.
Whatever you had planned meanwhile may fall through.
It won't cost you a thing.
No one but me will know.
How long is for me to decide.
I haven't said how long. I won't.
Say it. In your own words.
I want to hear you say it.
Don't open it yet. Say yes first.

In front of whoever is there.

Say yes to me. Just once, and mean it.
I'd like a rule between us. Your first one. Will you keep it?
Stay with me tonight. On my terms.

Give me the command. Not on paper: to me.
One rule, only for us. Nobody else needs to know it.
We've drifted, you and I. Do you want this back?
It's gone, the command. Do you understand what that makes you?
I want to start this again. Properly, this time.
I want your evenings, as many as I like, when I like.
I want a say in how you look. And how you keep yourself.
Give me your device. And the Leash, while you're at it.
I want your service outside our scenes too. My quarters, your second home.
I want a say in who else you spend yourself on.
I want to give orders too. And to be called the one in command.
I've asked enough times. Give way to me. Here, now.
Let's begin again. A smaller step than before.
Let's begin again, once you've paid for how it ended.
I'd like it {when}. Don't rush it.

{Slots} of your time. Spend it on me?

{Slots} of your time, and I want all of it.
{Slots} of your time. Don't give it to anyone else.

{Slots}. As if you had better things to do.
It takes {slots}. I don't care what else you had.
{Who} will know exactly what you are.

{Slots}, and every minute of it for me.

{posture}. I've shown you a hundred times.

{Slots} of your time, which I'm taking.
